claim.value: Unresolved histories should continue to be followed through the agreed observation window.
claim.scope: Follow-up bounded by the prospectively agreed window.

provenance.rationale: P011 directly prescribes continued follow-up; P009 identifies the prospectively defined observation window.

signal_basis.value: Inspection reveals missing links, contradictions or unexplained transitions that leave histories unresolved and call for participant clarification or further observation.
signal_basis.scope: Breaks in documented continuity within the bounded follow-up period; these do not establish customer failure.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans identify documentation gaps, prescribe clarification and restrict their interpretation; P011 bounds continued follow-up.
This procedural claim requires no unresolved empirical relation to supply its warrant.

rationale: Unresolved documentation warrants continued information gathering through the agreed window. The claim neither guarantees that follow-up will resolve the history nor treats missing records as evidence of customer failure.
uncertainty: Follow-up may leave some histories unresolved; this does not undermine the bounded follow-up requirement.
